children: A Polymarket submarket tied to the Boston Red Sox vs. New York Yankees event saw the probability of the "over" option for "first 5 innings total runs above 5.5" jump from 20.5% one hour earlier to 50%, a 29.5% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was monitored by Catcher Predict, which noted that sudden news may have affected the market.

title: Polymarket Red Sox-Yankees Submarket Swings to 50% After Sharp Move
